source_state: New unsealed draft written immediately before Root's veto. No claim-bound raw candidate, independent proof gate or canonical wrapper was created for V1. Its bytes are now preserved unchanged.
exact_veto: If two outside triple-concurrence points p,q share one D2 triangle, that shared triangle has p,q and only one S point. Each of p,q then has five guaranteed S neighbors (one plus two plus two), not six. The V1 inference y_p,y_q<=-4 and squared norm>=32 on the shared-fan branch is unsupported. Five neighbors give y_p,y_q<=-3 and squared norm>=18, which alone is compatible with norm<=28.
secondary_editorial_veto: For |S|=18 in99 vertices, there are81 outside vertices and79 after removing p,q. The V1 sentence84 outside/82 remaining reused the fifteen-point count incorrectly. Its scalar sum/norm argument did not depend on that erroneous count, but the literal numbers must be corrected in a new version.

The disjoint3+3 fan branch genuinely gives six S neighbors at each p/q and supports the later triangle-energy argument.
